Bugesera.data_source: NASA POWER Agroclimatology & Meteo Rwanda Gridded Station Network
Bugesera.data_coverage_status: Complete (12/12 seasons verified for rainfall & temperature)
primary_stress_factors: Recurrent mid-season dry spells exceeding 12 days
Daytime heat stress accelerating evapotranspiration (Max temp: 28.5°C)

season_a.rainfall_pattern: Regularly distributed rainfall across the entire crop vegetative cycle
season_a.primary_risk: Steady germination conditions with low drought vulnerability

season_b.rainfall_pattern: Front-loaded heavy downpours (March–April), followed by a pronounced dry period (May–June)
season_b.primary_risk: Early deluge erosion & fungal pressure, followed by late dry spell during grain filling

moisture_deficit.name: Moisture Deficit Defense
moisture_deficit.how_calculated: Evaluates maximum dry spell days relative to crop water demand (ETc ~ 520mm baseline) and FAO/AGLW monthly estimated effective rainfall. Uses the FAO empirical regression equation to estimate effective precipitation rather than unadjusted gross precipitation.

excess_deluge.name: Excess Deluge & Erosion Defense
excess_deluge.how_calculated: Measures frequency of torrential downpours (>30mm/day). In steep terraced districts, deluge events trigger hillside soil erosion and fertilizer leaching.

thermal_envelope.name: Thermal Envelope Defense
thermal_envelope.how_calculated: Evaluates temperatures against crop-specific physiological thresholds. Penalties trigger when nocturnal chill drops below T_base or daytime heat exceeds T_opt_max.

rainfall_regularity.name: Rainfall Regularity
rainfall_regularity.how_calculated: Compares seasonal rainy day frequency against the district's historical P10–P90 empirical quantiles. Scores steady rainfall delivery vs clustered storms.

unmonitored_indicators.soil_moisture: Direct root-zone sensor unavailable (Biophysical proxy: Sentinel-2 VHI)
unmonitored_indicators.relative_humidity: Not recorded in primary baseline tables

moisture_deficit.name: Moisture Deficit Defense
moisture_deficit.how_calculated: Evaluates maximum dry spell days relative to crop water demand (ETc ~ 520mm baseline) and FAO/AGLW monthly estimated effective rainfall. Uses the FAO empirical regression equation to estimate effective precipitation rather than unadjusted gross precipitation.

excess_deluge.name: Excess Deluge & Erosion Defense
excess_deluge.how_calculated: Measures frequency of torrential downpours (>30mm/day). In steep terraced districts, deluge events trigger hillside soil erosion and fertilizer leaching.

thermal_envelope.name: Thermal Envelope Defense
thermal_envelope.how_calculated: Evaluates temperatures against crop-specific physiological thresholds. Penalties trigger when nocturnal chill drops below T_base or daytime heat exceeds T_opt_max.

rainfall_regularity.name: Rainfall Regularity
rainfall_regularity.how_calculated: Compares seasonal rainy day frequency against the district's historical P10–P90 empirical quantiles. Scores steady rainfall delivery vs clustered storms.
